turns.user: Hi, my rubber plant was delivered this morning and the pot is cracked.
turns.reference_answer: Sorry about that. A cracked pot counts as damaged on arrival; report it within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the item and the box, and we will send a replacement or a refund.

turns.user: ok where do I send the photos?
turns.reference_answer: Send them to support by chat or at help@leafy.example within 48 hours of delivery: photos of the cracked pot and of the box it arrived in.

turns.user: And if the plant itself starts dying next week, is that covered too?
turns.reference_answer: Yes. After the 48-hour window, plant problems fall under the 30-day Plant Care Guarantee from delivery: submit a claim with two photos and a specialist reviews it within 2 business days.

turns.user: Would the replacement for the pot count against that?
turns.reference_answer: No. Damaged-on-arrival replacements do not count as the one replacement allowed under the Plant Care Guarantee.

turns.user: How much is the collector plan for the plant club?
turns.reference_answer: The Collector plan is $49 per month for a medium or rare plant in a 6-inch pot.

turns.user: I'm on the cheaper one now. If I upgrade today, when does it kick in? Today's the 22nd.
turns.reference_answer: Because it is before the 25th, upgrading from Starter to Collector today applies to next month's box, which will be charged at $49 on the 25th.

turns.user: and if I'd waited until the 26th?
turns.reference_answer: Changes made on or after the 25th apply to the following month's box, so the upgrade would only take effect one box later.

turns.user: Will the one I'm upgrading to still avoid sending plants I already own?
turns.reference_answer: Yes. On either plan you can list up to 3 plants you already own so we avoid sending duplicates, though you can't choose a specific plant.

turns.user: I see two charges of $64.50 for the same order.
turns.reference_answer: First check whether one is a pending authorisation that will drop off. If both have posted, send the order number and the last four digits of the card and the duplicate is refunded within 3 business days of confirmation.

turns.user: Both say posted. Order LF-381204, card ending 7712.
turns.reference_answer: Thanks. Since both charges have posted, the duplicate will be refunded within 3 business days of confirmation.

turns.user: Can that refund go to my other card instead? I closed that one.
turns.reference_answer: No. Refunds only go to the original payment method. The bank will normally pass it to the replacement card or account; alternatively you can take instant Leafy store credit.

turns.user: Fine, how long will it take to show up then?
turns.reference_answer: Card refunds typically take 5 to 10 business days to appear once issued, depending on the bank. Store credit would be instant.

turns.user: Hi! I live about 1,500 miles from your nearest greenhouse. How long would delivery take?
turns.reference_answer: Over 1,000 miles is Zone 3: Standard delivery takes 5 to 8 business days and Express is not available.

turns.user: Hmm. Could I pay extra to get it faster?
turns.reference_answer: No. Express is not available in Zone 3, so Standard (5 to 8 business days) is the only option.

turns.user: What if the plant I want is one of the XL ones?
turns.reference_answer: XL plants ship Standard only anyway and add a $20 handling fee on top of shipping.

turns.user: And would that fee go away if my order's over $75?
turns.reference_answer: No. Orders of $75 or more get free Standard shipping, but the $20 XL handling fee still applies.

turns.user: What do I get with Leafy Plus?
turns.reference_answer: For $59 a year: free Standard shipping with no minimum, free change-of-mind returns on non-living items, a 90-day Plant Care Guarantee, 10% member pricing on pots and accessories, and early access to rare plant drops.

turns.user: Does the longer guarantee apply to plants I bought before joining?
turns.reference_answer: No. The 90-day guarantee covers plants ordered while the membership is active.

turns.user: If I sign up and change my mind in a week, can I get the money back?
turns.reference_answer: Yes, a full refund is given if you cancel within 14 days of purchase and have not used any member benefits.

turns.user: What if I'd already used the free shipping by then?
turns.reference_answer: Then no refund is given, but you keep the benefits until the end of the paid year.

turns.user: ok and does it make express free too?
turns.reference_answer: No. Leafy Plus does not include free Express shipping; Express stays $14.95.

turns.user: I just ordered a ZZ plant, like 20 minutes ago. Can I still add a pot to it?
turns.reference_answer: Orders can be changed free of charge within 2 hours of being placed, from the My Orders page, so you can still change it.

turns.user: Nice. And if I only get round to it tonight, about 5 hours from now?
turns.reference_answer: After 2 hours the order enters the packing queue and can't be changed online; support can try to intercept it but it's not guaranteed, so you would likely need a separate order.

turns.user: Can I at least put a promo code on it then?
turns.reference_answer: No. Promo codes cannot be applied after an order has been placed; you could use it on the new order instead.

turns.user: Is the pothos safe for cats?
turns.reference_answer: No. Pothos is not pet-safe.

turns.user: Oh no. My cat just chewed one of its leaves.
turns.reference_answer: Please contact your vet or local poison control service immediately. I'm also escalating this to a Support Lead.

turns.user: He seems ok. What could I get instead that won't hurt him?
turns.reference_answer: Pet-safe options include calathea, spider plant, parlour palm, Boston fern and peperomia; please still check with your vet.

turns.user: I want to return a watering can I got 2 weeks ago, never used.
turns.reference_answer: Non-living items can be returned within 30 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging. Start the return from My Orders.

turns.user: Will it cost me anything?
turns.reference_answer: Change-of-mind returns cost a flat $6.95, deducted from the refund, unless you are a Leafy Plus member, in which case they are free.

turns.user: I printed the label 9 days ago but never dropped it off. Is it still ok?
turns.reference_answer: No. Return labels expire after 7 days, so you will need to generate a new label and drop the parcel off within 7 days.

turns.user: When would I see the money after they get it?
turns.reference_answer: The refund is issued within 5 business days of the return arriving at the warehouse, to the original payment method; card refunds then typically take 5 to 10 business days to appear.

turns.user: My order was supposed to arrive last week and tracking hasn't changed since Monday.
turns.reference_answer: If tracking has not updated for 4 business days, support opens an investigation with the courier, which takes up to 5 business days.

turns.user: It's been 6 business days now.
turns.reference_answer: That is over the 4-business-day threshold, so support will open a courier investigation, which takes up to 5 business days.

turns.user: What happens if they can't find it?
turns.reference_answer: If the courier confirms it's lost, you get a free replacement or a full refund, your choice.

turns.user: I'd take the replacement. Would that one ship express?
turns.reference_answer: The policy says lost parcels get a free replacement, but it does not specify Express shipping for the replacement, so this can't be promised; support can confirm.

turns.user: ok. and it had a plant in it, so it'll only ship early in the week right?
turns.reference_answer: Yes. Live plants ship Monday to Wednesday only.

turns.user: My bird of paradise has lost almost half its leaves in 3 weeks. I followed the care card exactly.
turns.reference_answer: Losing more than a third of its leaves within 30 days counts as significant decline, so submit a Plant Care Guarantee claim with two photos; a specialist reviews it within 2 business days.

turns.user: I already submitted one last week and heard nothing.
turns.reference_answer: Apologise: claims should be reviewed within 2 business days, so this is overdue. A one-time goodwill store credit of up to $15 can be offered for the delayed reply.

turns.user: This is honestly the third time I've chased this. I'm really fed up.
turns.reference_answer: Apologise and escalate to a Support Lead, as the issue has been raised three or more times; a goodwill store credit of up to $15 may be offered.

turns.user: Will I at least get the same plant again?
turns.reference_answer: If the claim is approved you get one free replacement of the same plant, or store credit if it's out of stock.
